## Certificate of Visa Eligibility application for P1

| Blank | Entry | What to complete by hand |
|---|---|---|
| B01 | SURNAME_P1 | |
| B02 | GIVEN_P1 MIDDLE_P1 | Copy the given names in passport order. Include the middle name only if it appears among the passport’s given names. |
| B03 | NEEDS-YOU | Supply your name in Chinese characters if this field applies. |
| B04 | √ MALE | |
| B05 | DATE_P1 | Rewrite the restored date as `yyyy/mm/dd`. |
| B06 | INDIAN | |
| B07 | PLACE_P1 | Enter only the country from the restored birthplace. If it shows only a city or region, supply the country by hand. |
| B08 | NEEDS-YOU | Supply the national identity number requested by the form. |
| B09 | NEEDS-YOU | Check Yes or No for prior use of another name when entering or leaving Korea. If Yes, supply the other family and given names. |
| B10 | NEEDS-YOU | Check Yes or No for multiple citizenships. If Yes, give the other citizenship details. |
| B11 | NEEDS-YOU | Check the passport category shown on your passport. If Other, specify the type. |
| B12 | ID_P1 | |
| B13 | INDIA | |
| B14 | NEEDS-YOU | Supply the passport’s place of issue. |
| B15 | ISSUED_P1 | If the field specifies `yyyy/mm/dd`, rewrite the restored date in that format. |
| B16 | 2029/06/04 | |
| B17 | NEEDS-YOU | Check Yes or No for another valid passport. If Yes, supply its type, number, issuing country and expiry date. |
| B18 | NEEDS-YOU | Supply your home-country address in India. |
| B19 | ADDRESS_P1 | Use your current UK residential address. |
| B20 | PHONE_P1 | Use this here if it is your mobile number. |
| B21 | NEEDS-YOU | Supply a general telephone number if applicable. If your stored phone number is your general telephone number, move it here. |
| B22 | NEEDS-YOU | Supply your email address. |
| B23 | GIVEN_P2 SURNAME_P2 | Enter your wife’s full name in English. |
| B24 | UNITED KINGDOM | |
| B25 | PHONE_P2 | |
| B26 | WIFE | |
| B27 | √ MARRIED | |
| B28 | SURNAME_P2 | |
| B29 | GIVEN_P2 | |
| B30 | DATE_P2 | Rewrite the restored date as `yyyy/mm/dd`. |
| B31 | INDIAN | |
| B32 | ADDRESS_P1 | Use the UK address you share. |
| B33 | PHONE_P2 | |
| B34 | √ YES · 1 CHILD | Enter `1` in the number-of-children box. |
| B35 | √ MASTER’S / DOCTORAL DEGREE | |
| B36 | NEEDS-YOU | Supply the name of the school that awarded your master’s degree. |
| B37 | NEEDS-YOU | Supply the school’s city, province or equivalent region, and country. |
| B38 | √ EMPLOYED | |
| B39 | NEEDS-YOU | Supply your company’s name. |
| B40 | NEEDS-YOU | Supply your job title. |
| B41 | NEEDS-YOU | Supply the company office’s full address. |
| B42 | NEEDS-YOU | Supply the company office’s telephone number. |

Use block letters when copying the restored entries onto the form.
